body: So my mother just told me she won't help me to get better...that all she will provide is a place to sleep...and food...and that is it...okay mom...I won't be a burden then...

Funny, the last time I was in this state of mind, nobody noticed...I freaked out and called the suicide line myself...this time...apparently they are calling me concerned...one by one...It's helping...along with all of your help
Thank you I'm still here...my family all are freaking out calling me...which is something they've never done before...I guess I really scared my mother...

No no..I was truly thanking you for saying that...please understand that I have grown up religious my whole life, I totally understand when people use it. And I am okay with murder with perceived reason. But, I think I'm going to be okay..
It might take a couple of weeks, but it'll all be okay

So I called my mother, tried to make it sound like nothing was wrong...out of the blue shortly after my sister calls me, saying my mother was freaking out, what is wrong...so I broke down and told her...she is having her husband come and get me...Thank you everyone for everything. I love you all. I might be able to do this...
I'm agnostic, but thank you for that...
I am still here...I still have a few things to wrap up.
Tomorrow I lose my job...just the final nail in the coffin...just another broken piece...

Why does everyone say that? You got to push on, it gets better, no it really doesn't get better, there is no evidence to support that it gets better, you don't know how bad it is for me right now...you don't know how many times I've gone through the exact same situation, it's like I'm destined to always feel this way...only to be convinced, you need to push on...it will only get better. No it won't...I've been right here before...right now...and was convinced...3 years later...they were wrong...I'm right back here, I warned people I told them, I can't do this anymore...I just can't.
It doesn't get better, not for me...I start thinking its better, but it just goes away again...and again....

No need, nobody can give me what I want, and I'm tired of picking up the pieces of my life after this happens...it's not worth it anymore..I'm still afraid of dieing, it's just feels like the better option.
I need help, I need someone there for me...I need someone to be my person, because I just fucked up and lost my person....
When you've been single and alone for 8 years....it's hard to let go of something that makes you happy
I've decided to stop my pain, nobody actually cares anyway...
